_provenance: Provenance is set via NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE=true on the release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml). Changesets honors that env var when running npm publish.
_ignore: Every workspace that is NOT part of a release must be listed here, or `changeset status` surfaces it as a spurious patch bump (changesets versions private packages by default). al-app-docs was missing — added 2026-08-27; apps/docs landed after this list was last touched, which is the same drift that once left the deleted al-app-enhance in here. @southleft/altitude-mcp is listed for the sl-web-components reason, only sharper: it is NOT private and carries publishConfig.access=public, so without an entry a release could version and publish it before that was ever a decision. Whether it and @southleft/sl-web-components ship is an open question in the publish-altitude-v2 spec — listing both keeps the release surface honest until it is settled. Remove an entry the moment that package is meant to publish. check-changesets-config.js now enforces this list in BOTH directions.
